status.reason: The pristine resident ASM closes selection, planted arming, enemy proximity, blast construction, damage class, permanence, and quota flow. The exact carried/thrown activation owner is a low-return residual; the existing synchronized D02 Interpreter movie can be reused if full promotion is later required.

planted_state_machine.armed_state: slot+0x02 == 1 after the common mature-plant gate
planted_state_machine.trigger_transition: a qualifying enemy switches the slot to the explosion animation script through 0x8005C8D4

blast_constructor.effect_helper: 0x800583F4 spawns 24 alternating ctor-12/13 records, gates positional SFX, and plays sound 13; they are not promoted here as 24 independent damage hits

permanent_kill_flow.death_tail: enemy+0x6E := 999; +0x60 := 0; +0x5C sets 0x0880 and clears bit 0x0002; +0x70 receives the hit/death program
permanent_kill_flow.quota_store: 0x80059300 decrements once only when the mine hit reaches the permanent death tail
permanent_kill_flow.boundary: A mine contact dealing -2 does not bypass local HP. Permanence is selected on the lethal hit, not on every overlap.

player_and_throw_boundary.planted_trigger: The state-1 trigger scans enemy pointers, not Flik, so Flik proximity alone cannot detonate the planted mine.
player_and_throw_boundary.blast_player_branch: At terminal resolution, slot+0x2E bit 0x40 admits the shared player-damage handler at 0x8005C9F8; the handler then clears bits 0x40 and 0x02.
player_and_throw_boundary.interpreter_control: The operator-observed D02 Interpreter movie throws the gold mine at input 304 and shortly collides with a spider. Its prior clean and armed normal-speed runs ended at identical frame, cycle, and RAM hash.
player_and_throw_boundary.residual: The exact instruction owner converting the carried/thrown mine into terminal blast state was not captured by the D02 +0x20-only watch set.

capsule_audit.reason: The stable plant type at slot+0x00 never equals 11, quota remains 15, and coverage contains no mine handler, permanence gate, permanent-bit, or quota-decrement block.
capsule_audit.negative_control_use: Accepted only as proof that passive capsule reconstruction does not invent a mine event.

accepted_capsule_probe.note: The original +0x00 stable-type decode is correct.

rejected_animation_selector_probe.reason: It incorrectly treated changing animation selector slot+0x06 as stable plant type; none of its plant-event labels are used.

closure.reopen_rule: Reopen for full promotion only if a MOD needs the carried/thrown transition owner, or if a current synchronized runtime tuple is required. Reuse D02 first; request a new Interpreter movie only if D02 lacks the needed planted/armed interval.
